私立探偵 しりつたんてい explicitly names a private detective; 探偵小説 たんていしょうせつ names a detective story. Useful short contextual combinations if needed, not two extra articles or proof that all 探偵 are private or fictional.
偵察 ていさつ is transitive-suru scouting/reconnaissance. Useful alternate whole-word example if needed; no second support article required solely to repeat the same テイ reading.

Complete reconnaissance satellite, aircraft, scouting party, surveillance flight, drone and military reconnaissance-in-force families retained. These domain-specific compounds do not define every detective or require technical/military expansion. Leave outside the practical support article.
偵知 ていち is explicitly obsolete, with noun/transitive-suru spying-out/discovering senses. Do not promote it into a modern common-word example or add a new metadata reading.

内偵 ないてい names secret investigation/reconnaissance; 密偵 みってい separately names a spy/secret agent and spying with suru. Preserve those whole-word meanings without treating every investigator as a spy or ordinary 調査 as necessarily secret.

名探偵 めいたんてい is a great detective; the homophonous 迷探偵 is explicitly jocular and a pun for an inept detective. Recognition of the second spelling is not an ordinary interchangeable great-detective spelling. Neither needs an article here.

偵察要員 ていさつよういん is explicitly a baseball tactic involving a nominal starter replaced after the opposing pitcher is known. Do not interpret this exact family's gloss as generic military reconnaissance personnel or invent that meaning from the written parts.
サイバー探偵 サイバーたんてい and 安楽椅子探偵 あんらくいすたんてい are cybersleuth and armchair detective. Retain complete evidence without technical or fiction-focused expansion.
探偵団 たんていだん has both detective-team and study-group/club senses. Its second sense prevents a universal literal detective-team compositional rule. No extra article or general 団 teaching is needed.

探偵社 たんていしゃ and 探偵事務所 たんていじむしょ name detective agencies; 探偵業 たんていぎょう names detective work/industry. Retained whole-family support for occupation/activity context, not a legal definition, level assignment or three new article requirements.
名探偵コナン めいたんていコナン is explicitly a work title, Detective Conan/Case Closed, not a new ordinary person-noun sense or an authorization to reproduce franchise material. Keep source evidence only.

comparisonDispositions.disposition: The separate 刑事 でか family marks a special kanji reading and slang; its katakana デカ reading has re_nokanji. This is not the existing article's primary けいじ identity and must not silently replace it or be used as evidence for component ケイ/ジ.

スパイ is a noun/transitive-suru spy/spying loanword. No current article exists; do not add another support article just to multiply synonyms. The family helps interpret source spy glosses, not classify all detectives.

刑事 けいじ has police-detective and noun/prenominal criminal-matter senses. Preserve the existing N3 article and both senses. A generic detective label overlaps 探偵 and motivates a direct guard; a police/private tendency is not an absolute dictionary-wide exclusivity rule.

警官 けいかん and 警察官 けいさつかん identify police officers. The actual existing 警官 article is N5 and is not to be relabelled, rewritten or treated as identical to every investigator. No current 警察官 support mapping is required.

警察 けいさつ names the police and abbreviated officer/station senses; the complete family additionally has a colloquial enforcer/busybody suffix sense. ケーサツ and ケイサツ are search-only kana. Do not manufacture a pure organization-only rule or replace the N4 article's primary reading.

探る さぐる is a transitive godan with tactile search, probing/investigating/spying-on, and exploratory senses. Its investigative second sense matters for possible direct quiz guards against the new support's activity sense. Not every use is covert, and its existing exclusion list creates no transitive guard for new 探偵.

調べる しらべる is transitive ichidan examining/looking up/investigating, while 調査 ちょうさ is noun/transitive-suru investigation/inquiry/survey. Their broad senses can overlap secret investigation without either necessarily being covert. Existing N4/N3 identities and levels remain unchanged; settle direct guards against the final support label rather than narrow their meanings.

探す and 捜す share さがす in one transitive godan family, with a desired/lost spelling tendency and a separate searching-through sense. Their actual existing N4/N2 articles are not duplicate supports for テイ and do not supply standalone さがす for 偵.
